definitions.explanation: The outward look or style of something or someone.
Being proper or fitting for a situation.

notes:
{格好|かっこう} has two main uses: describing outward appearance/attire (noun) and meaning suitable or ideal (na-adjective).

SENSE 1 — APPEARANCE:
Refers to how someone looks, especially their clothing or posture.
- {格好|かっこう}いい/かっこいい: cool, stylish
- {格好|かっこう}{悪|わる}い/かっこ{悪|わる}い: uncool, lame, embarrassing
- {格好|かっこう}をつける: to try to look cool, to put on airs
- {変|へん}な{格好|かっこう}: strange outfit/appearance

SENSE 2 — SUITABLE:
Used as a na-adjective meaning ideal or appropriate for a purpose.
- {格好|かっこう}の{場所|ばしょ}: ideal spot
- {格好|かっこう}の{機会|きかい}: perfect opportunity
- {格好|かっこう}の{的|まと}: easy target

WRITING:
Also written as {恰好|かっこう} (older kanji) or in hiragana. Often shortened to かっこ in casual speech: かっこいい, かっこ{悪|わる}い.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {姿|すがた}: figure, form (more literary)
- {服装|ふくそう}: attire, dress (specifically clothing)
- {見|み}た{目|め}: outward appearance, looks
